definitions.gloss: archipelago, island chain, chain of islands
definitions.explanation: A group of islands arranged in a line or arc. Most commonly used to refer to Japan as an island chain.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{列島|れっとう}は{南北|なんぼく}に{長|なが}い。
examples.english: The Japanese archipelago is long from north to south.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{列島|れっとう}を{縦断|じゅうだん}した。
examples.english: The typhoon passed through the archipelago from end to end.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{列島|れっとう}は{四|よっ}つの{大|おお}きな{島|しま}と{多数|たすう}の{小|ちい}さな{島|しま}で{構成|こうせい}されている。
examples.english: The Japanese archipelago is made up of four large islands and numerous small ones.

notes:
Compound of {列|れつ} (row, line) + {島|とう} (island). Most commonly encountered in the phrase {日本|にほん}{列島|れっとう} (the Japanese archipelago).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本|にほん}{列島|れっとう} (the Japanese archipelago)
- {列島|れっとう}を{縦断|じゅうだん}する (to traverse the archipelago)
- {列島|れっとう}{全体|ぜんたい} (the entire archipelago)
- {列島|れっとう}{各地|かくち} (various parts of the archipelago)

USAGE:
In weather forecasts and news, {列島|れっとう} alone often refers to Japan: {列島|れっとう}に{寒波|かんぱ}が{到来|とうらい} (a cold wave hits the archipelago = Japan). This usage is so common that the word is strongly associated with Japan in everyday Japanese.
